exercises.question: Which sentence uses a relative clause correctly?
options: Vivo en un barrio que tiene muchos servicios. [I live in a neighbourhood that has many services.]
Vivo en un barrio quien tiene muchos servicios. [I live in a neighbourhood who has many services.]
Vivo en un barrio donde tiene muchos servicios. [I live in a neighbourhood where it has many services.]

exercises.sentence: La vivienda es más __ que la otra.
exercises.english: The home is brighter than the other one.
The flat is too small for three people.

sentences: Había una fuga. [There was a leak.]
Llamamos al propietario. [We called the landlord.]
Después llegó el técnico. [Then the technician arrived.]

exercises.question: Which connector shows a consequence?
options: así que [so]
aunque [although]
donde [where]

exercises.sentence: Mientras __ la cena, el agua empezó a salir.
exercises.english: While we were preparing dinner, the water started coming out.
If I had more time, I would renovate the bathroom.

exercises.question: Which hypothetical sentence is correct?
options: Si pudiera, ampliaría la sala. [If I could, I would enlarge the living room.]
Si podría, ampliaría la sala. [If I could, I would enlarge the living room.]
Si pueda, ampliaría la sala. [If I could, I would enlarge the living room.]

exercises.sentence: El barrio donde vivo es bastante tranquilo y tiene muchos servicios.
options: The neighbourhood where I live is quite quiet and has many services.
The neighbourhood where I lived was very noisy and far away.
The building where I work is quiet and has many offices.

exercises.sentence: Había mucho ruido en la calle, por eso cerramos la ventana.
options: There was a lot of noise in the street, so we closed the window.
The street was quiet, but we closed the window anyway.
There will be a lot of noise, so we will close the window.

exercises.sentence: Si tuviera más espacio, ampliaría la sala.
exercises.english: If I had more space, I would enlarge the living room.

options: Elegiría una más luminosa que la actual, aunque el alquiler sería más alto. [I would choose a brighter one than the current one, although the rent would be higher.]
Elegiría una más luminosa como la actual, aunque el alquiler sería más alto. [I would choose a brighter one than the current one, although the rent would be higher.]
Elegiría una más luminosa de la actual, aunque el alquiler sería más alto. [I would choose a brighter one than the current one, although the rent would be higher.]
El agua empezó a salir, así que llamamos al propietario. [The water started coming out, so we called the landlord.]
El agua empezará a salir, así que llamaremos al propietario. [The water will start coming out, so we will call the landlord.]
El agua empiece a salir, así que llamemos al propietario. [The water start (subjunctive) coming out, so we call (subjunctive) the landlord.]

exercises.question: Which description combines an evaluation and a reason?
options: Prefiero una vivienda funcional porque necesito espacio para trabajar. [I prefer a functional home because I need space to work.]
Prefiero vivir en una casa grande y luminosa cerca del centro. [I prefer living in a big, bright house near the centre.]
La vivienda tiene tres habitaciones, dos baños y una cocina muy grande. [The home has three bedrooms, two bathrooms and a very large kitchen.]

exercises.sentence: La vivienda perfecta tendría bastante __ para vivir bien.
exercises.english: The perfect home would have enough privacy to live well.

template.prompt: Say that you would choose a home that is brighter than your current flat.
template.answer: Elegiría una vivienda que es más luminosa que mi piso actual.

template.prompt: Say that if you could renovate your home, you would enlarge the living room because you need more space.
template.answer: Si pudiera reformar mi casa, ampliaría la sala porque necesito más espacio.
